record.name: Syria
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The communications ministry is running AI training and partnership activity, and no national AI strategy or evaluation body was found, though official information is scarce after the conflict.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

Re-ran searches in Arabic and English for a government-designated institute that evaluates advanced models, or a commitment, proposal or study naming one. No qualifying institute or commitment was identified; results described AI training initiatives, private-sector memoranda with the communications ministry (aiXplain, GO) and Syria's pavilion at LEAP 2026, with no published AI strategy. Kept low: state news agency reports cover AI training and a conference, not a strategy or governance body. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: The recorded ar query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Some submitted strings contain site. rather than site:; these literal strings are preserved and are not treated as domain-restricted searches. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: SY-search = searches 1, 2 (en, ar). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger. On 24 October 2026 the record was searched again in Arabic and English; the result links of each query were matched against registered sources in the same way.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Communications and Technology
related_bodies.role: It co-sponsors AI training initiatives and the first national AI conference (June 2026); no safety or evaluation mandate was described.

record.notes:
The earlier state news agency report covers a June 2026 AI conference and a one-million-users training initiative. A search result claiming a 2025-2030 strategy and national AI council appeared to concern Egypt and was excluded.

The Ministry of Information held a government AI-use workshop on 30 December 2025. The workshop took place in Damascus. Searches covered indexed public English and Arabic sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.
